_doc: Vetted RTSP sources for the nightly replacement (scripts/agent/rtsp_replace.py, docs/RTSP-NIGHTLY.md). Only entries with a 'vetted' date are ever used as a replacement; the others only classify a failing stream as 'public test stream'. A 'loopback' source is only valid on the hosts listed in the env var named by 'hostsEnv' (private config, comma list: the hosts that run vpt-rtsp/mediamtx). No credentials, ever: an IP camera is never in this file.
policy: Loopback smoke only (owner/manager, 2026-11-11): public RTSP (554/TCP) is blocked from codebox and 3 lab hosts, so no public source is vetted and a dead public stream is reported, never replaced, until one is vetted from a host that will use it (a non-554 port or RTSP-over-HTTP counts, rtsp_check.py probes whatever URL it is given).

sources.note: mediamtx loop of big_buck_bunny_360p.mp4 (backend_host/config/rtsp/mediamtx.yml); h264 640x360 24 fps, 12/12 distinct frames on a host running vpt-rtsp
unvetted: port 554 to it was blocked from codebox and 3 lab hosts on 2026-11-11 (stream may be gone)
